summary: Workflow identity, optional trusted runtime identity, and Git-local bounded-run evidence.

provides.name: workflow-fingerprint
provides.summary: Deterministic skill-owned package fingerprint, separate from repository provenance; supports source and installed layouts and explicit unborn identity.

provides.name: external-runtime-context-v1
provides.summary: Validate externally supplied identity; absent trusted context has unavailable provenance and null identity fields.

provides.name: bounded-run-evidence
provides.summary: availability, active, begin, finish, recover and check preserve raw invocation/snapshot/check facts; lifecycle requires a resolved HEAD.

state_owned.name: git-local-evidence-runs-and-snapshot-refs
state_owned.summary: Run manifests and check captures under worktree Git metadata, with immutable snapshot objects retained by refs.

invariants.statement: Fingerprint selection/framing semantics are a compatibility boundary; absolute installation location is excluded.
Runtime identity is not inferred from model self-identification or configured model names.
Evidence uses a temporary index, does not alter the real index, and does not decide acceptance. Parallel multi-agent execution in one worktree is unsupported.
